itens.titulo: Hackers exploram falhas no iPhone e Android. Uma simples visita a um site podia abrir a porta a ataques
itens.resumo: Investigadores da Sekoia identificaram uma campanha que explorou vulnerabilidades corrigidas em iOS e Android através de websites comprometidos, domínios falsos e um serviço de análise web adulterado. The post Hackers exploram falhas no iPhone e Android. Uma simples visita a um site podia abrir a porta a ataques appeared first on Tek Notícias .

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-107622: The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.5 via a form-type…
itens.resumo: The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.5 via a form-type confusion attack through the `bf_post_type` parameter. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-119757: BTCPay Server before 2.4.2, including 2.4.2 release candidates, contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
itens.resumo: BTCPay Server before 2.4.2, including 2.4.2 release candidates, contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to retrieve .macaroon credential files for an LND (Lightning Network Daemon) node. Attackers can use the exposed macaroon to gain full control of the LND node, including moving funds, resulting in theft of funds from affected deployments.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-105769: kaniko can send the build's Azure (Entra ID) access token to lookalike ACR registry hosts
itens.resumo: kaniko before v1.25.20 can send a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) access token for Azure Resource Manager to a registry host an attacker controls. A Dockerfile that references an image on a lookalike host, such as FROM x.azurecr.io.attacker.com/img , is enough. The build needs no RUN instruction and never has to push. The flaw is in the Azure Container Registry (ACR) credential helper, github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env . kaniko links it into the executor and warmer (the built-in helper) and also builds it as the standalone docker-credential-acr-env binary. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-122302: Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace admins to create resources beyond their RBAC because…
itens.resumo: Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace admins to create resources beyond their RBAC because generate-rule admission checks verify the controller's permissions, not the author's. Attackers can create a namespaced Policy with generate rules targeting other namespaces or cluster-scoped kinds, making the background controller create or clone resources cluster-wide.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-122321: Kyverno 1.18.0 before 1.19.2 contains a signature verification bypass in verifyImages because cached verification results are keyed by the…
itens.resumo: Kyverno 1.18.0 before 1.19.2 contains a signature verification bypass in verifyImages because cached verification results are keyed by the image reference string (such as a tag) rather than bound to the verified digest, so cache hits skip signature and attestation checks. An attacker who can submit workloads and move a registry tag can warm the cache with a signed image, repoint the tag, and have Kyverno admit the workload and use mutateDigest to pin the unverified digest.

itens.titulo: Hackers Hide Linux Backdoor in Control Web Panel Server to Execute Commands Without Logs
itens.resumo: A backdoor has been found hiding in the web server that runs Control Web Panel (CWP), a free panel for managing Linux hosting servers, researchers at QiAnXin's XLab said this week. The backdoored web server executes commands that attackers send via web requests, and those requests never appear in its access logs. Installing it takes root access, so the attackers must already control the server.
